summary: Appeal challenging uphold of conviction for murder, kidnapping, extortion; prosecution case reliant on circumstantial evidence including DNA match; High Court affirmed trial court's conviction of appellant while acquitting co-accused; appellant argued fabricated case, absence of motive evidence, unreliable recovery process, improper use of confessional statement; contested admissibility of Section 27 Evidence Act disclosures; challenged DNA evidence reliability; issues around abduction-killing at Raichur railway station, concealment of body remains.
